design_concept: Contemporary Catalan Estate & Architectural Hospitality. A fusion of raw Mediterranean rural stone heritage, modernist Iberian editorial typography, and fluid cinematic scrollytelling. Avoids all rustic kitsch, script fonts, and wedding cliches in favor of high-craft architectural poise.

entry_surfaces./: cinematic full-bleed atmospheric video hero with masked line reveal text over dark tinted scrim and sticky crystal glass nav

layout_blueprints.structure: Single-page responsive layout with multi-language engine (CA default, ES, EN) and fast section anchor links.

sections.name: HERO
sections.layout: Full viewport height (100vh / min-h-[700px]) relative container with ambient Mediterranean estate video loop, layered film grain, subtle gradient scrim, staggered line reveal typography, brand tagline, and floating discovery action.

sections.name: 03 GALERIA

sections.name: 04 CONTACTE
sections.title: Tens alguna cosa per celebrar?

sections.name: FOOTER
sections.layout: Deep charcoal monolithic footer with massive architectural wordmark 'LA TORRE DEL GALL', legal/privacy links, newsletter/brochure download CTA, and Catalan estate heritage notice.

motion.smooth_scroll: Smooth momentum scrolling enabled via lenis (or React Lenis wrapper).

accessibility.contrast_check: Every text color tested: Charcoal #1A1A18 on #F9F7F2 has 14.8:1 ratio; Muted #575651 has 6.2:1 ratio; Olive #444F3C has 7.1:1 ratio. White on dark hero has >10:1 ratio with guaranteed gradient scrim.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Include prefers-reduced-motion media query fallback disabling aggressive transforms.
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full visible focus rings (ring-2 ring-[#444F3C] ring-offset-2), aria-expanded on dropdowns/modals, semantic heading hierarchy H1 -> H2 -> H3.

backend_integration.feedback: Instant client-side loading state, error alert on failure, and rich Sonner toast + in-form visual confirmation on success.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this exact design system. Use Playfair Display for headings and DM Sans for body text.
Set the Tailwind v4 styles in /app/frontend/src/index.css with the warm ivory light theme and font tokens.
Implement the full-screen cinematic video hero with custom play/pause/mute toggle and fallback image.
Implement the Catalan default trilingual switcher (CA / ES / EN) using a clean context or state hook.
Implement the backend FastAPI inquiry model and router in /app/backend/routers/inquiries.py with MongoDB storage.
Add Lenis smooth scrolling (or smooth wheel momentum) and Framer Motion reveals for that Awwwards feel.
Ensure all data-testid attributes are preserved for automated test agents.
